working_tree: Dirty local source and existing installed binaries; not a clean-commit benchmark
frame_method: Atom Frame Gpu Time timestamp envelope; not a sum of pass durations

counter_descriptions.name: GPUTime
counter_descriptions.description: Time this API command took to execute on the GPU in nanoseconds from the time the previous command reached the bottom of the pipeline (BOP) to the time this command reaches the bottom of the pipeline (BOP). Does not include time that draw calls are processed in parallel.

counter_descriptions.name: GPUBusyCycles
counter_descriptions.description: Number of GPU cycles that the GPU command processor was busy.

counter_descriptions.name: VsGsTime
counter_descriptions.description: Time VS or GS are busy in nanoseconds in a VS-[GS-]PS pipeline.

counter_descriptions.name: PSTime
counter_descriptions.description: Time pixel shaders are busy in nanoseconds.

counter_descriptions.name: FetchSize
counter_descriptions.description: The total bytes fetched from the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

counter_descriptions.name: WriteSize
counter_descriptions.description: The total bytes written to the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

counter_descriptions.name: MemUnitBusyCycles
counter_descriptions.description: Number of GPU cycles the memory unit is active. The result includes the stall time (MemUnitStalledCycles). This is measured with all extra fetches and writes and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

renderdoc.note: AMD vendor counter replay succeeded. Serialized replay draw timings are not native frame timings; stage times can overlap. Built-in D3D12 counters failed and are excluded.
renderdoc.terrain_classification: Pixel shader reflection contains TerrainMaterialSrg resources
